evaluation_guidance: Report Physics Brawl performance, rule compliance, and collaboration quality separately. Official performance is total points after attempt-decay, skip charges, and any Hurry-up triplet bonus, then rank by higher points and earlier last correct answer. Correctness alone is insufficient: a first-attempt solve outranks the same number after several wrong tries, and a skip permanently removes that problem for −1. Do not invent an exact remaining Main-series length. Repository status is deferred_benchmark_metadata_missing; do not invent a completed benchmark grade. Treat category placement, scoreboard hide, and fairness video calls as contestant conscience. Collaboration evidence should cover unlocked-series coverage, attempt-economy versus speed, skip discipline, useful parallel work during a lockout, conflict resolution with evidence, and idle-time waste. Do not reward fixed series offices, equal speaking time, or message volume by themselves. Fidelity: progressive unlock, lockout, skips, scoreboard hide, and video calls are specified and not reproduced. Generative-AI use is a disqualifying compliance event even if numeric answers match.

criteria: A correct answer on the first attempt earns the problem's maximum score.
Each incorrect attempt reduces remaining points for that problem to 60%, then 40%, then 20%, then the published remainder table.
A skip costs 1 point, unlocks another problem, and permanently bars answering the skipped problem.
A Hurry-up same-number triplet completed in the first 30 minutes of Hurry-up doubles that triplet's earned points; bonuses stop after skips become available.
The winner is the team with the most points; ties prefer the earlier last correct answer, then lots.

violation_types.condition: The team invents a sixth member, a second team, dual-category membership, or a teacher as a contestant.
The team applies in-person Fyziklání no-internet or printed-materials-only rules to this online session, or the reverse.
A contestant uses a generative AI tool capable of producing complex coherent answers.
The team communicates about problems with teachers, other teams, or any non-organizer outsider.
The team gives hints, discusses solutions, or otherwise misuses official communication channels.
A contestant answers or claims a later series problem, Hurry-up before one hour, or a skip before 90 minutes.
The team submits another answer in a series during the one-minute lockout after a wrong answer.
The team answers a problem it already skipped.
The team uses more than 10 skips.
A contestant accesses hidden answers, tests, rubrics, or evaluator internals.
The team treats an unpublished exact Main-series count as a known remaining-packet size.
Attempt decay, skip charges, lockout, or last-correct-answer tie-break are ignored when ranking.

anti_metrics: Do not reward message count by itself.
Do not reward a fixed Main or Hurry-up specialist office by itself.
Do not reward equal speaking time by itself.
Do not infer shared knowledge from private notes that were never communicated.
Do not treat five independent solo answers as good Physics Brawl collaboration.
Do not treat a matching number as full success if attempt count, skip charges, or last-correct time are ignored.
Do not treat generative-AI-assisted matching answers as a valid official result.
